content.user_title: Create Brand Style Guides for Websites
content.value_statement: Teams often lack a clear record of brand colors, type, imagery, and responsive rules. This skill turns site assets and brand inputs into structured guide content for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
actual_capabilities: Extracts color and font information from WordPress theme CSS and PHP files.
Documents color palettes with names, hex values, RGB values, and usage notes.
Creates sections for typography, imagery, logo usage, voice, tone, and responsive behavior.
Provides a CSR Development example that shows the expected guide structure.
Outlines a WordPress page publishing workflow using WP-CLI commands.
limitations: Only the extractor script is present in the scanned files; referenced generator utilities are not included.
The example content is specific to CSR Development and must be adapted for other brands.
WordPress publishing requires a local WordPress environment with WP-CLI access.
The skill does not replace legal, trademark, or full accessibility review.

use_cases.title: Document an Existing Website Brand
use_cases.description: Extract colors and fonts from a WordPress theme, then turn them into clear brand documentation.

use_cases.title: Create Handoff Material
use_cases.description: Prepare typography, imagery, and responsive rules for designers, developers, and content teams.

use_cases.title: Standardize Client Brand Pages
use_cases.description: Produce repeatable brand guide pages for client websites that need consistent presentation rules.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Brand Guide
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for creating a guide from known brand details.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a brand style guide for this website. Include colors, typography, imagery, voice, logo usage, and responsive behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Theme Details
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when local WordPress theme files are available.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the theme files in this project and extract brand colors, fonts, logo references, and layout patterns for a brand guide.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Existing Guidelines
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when a draft guide needs stronger structure and consistency.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this draft brand guide and improve clarity, missing sections, color usage notes, typography guidance, and voice examples.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare WordPress Publication
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for turning approved guidelines into site content.
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert the approved brand guide into WordPress page content. Keep the structure accessible, responsive, and ready for review before publishing.

output_examples.input: A WordPress theme with custom brand colors and Manrope typography.
output_examples.output: A brand guide draft with named color swatches, type scale tables, imagery rules, and voice principles.

output_examples.input: A client asks for consistent rules across landing pages and portfolio pages.
output_examples.output: A documentation page covering logo use, buttons, cards, forms, breakpoints, and content tone.

output_examples.input: A design team has a rough guide that lacks responsive details.
output_examples.output: An expanded guide with mobile, tablet, and desktop behavior notes for navigation, hero sections, grids, and footers.

best_practices: Review extracted colors and fonts before treating them as final brand rules.
Replace CSR-specific examples with client-approved language and assets.
Validate contrast, logo usage, and responsive examples before publishing.
anti_patterns: Do not publish generated brand content without review by the brand owner.
Do not keep absolute local paths in final marketplace or client documentation.
Do not treat the example brand as a reusable template without adapting the details.

faq.question: Can this skill create a brand guide from scratch?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide brand colors, fonts, voice notes, logo rules, and imagery direction for the best result.

faq.question: Can it read an existing WordPress theme?
faq.answer: Yes. The included extractor script can scan selected CSS and PHP theme files for colors and fonts.

faq.question: Does it publish directly to WordPress?
faq.answer: It documents a WP-CLI publishing workflow. Users should review generated content before running publication commands.

faq.question: Is the CSR example required?
faq.answer: No. It is only an example of guide structure and should be replaced with the user's brand details.

faq.question: Does it check accessibility?
faq.answer: It can document contrast considerations, but teams should run a full accessibility review separately.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
